devflow.name: Devflow
devflow.accuracy.title: Devflow’s rubrics here
devflow.accuracy.body: Devflow sends Jev each review finding, the card’s criteria with a summary of their evidence, the brief and the plan — never the diff — through the provider above. A new threshold goes in {path}.

devflow.accuracy.decisions.one: {rubric}: {count} decision, {labelled} labelled by what you did
devflow.accuracy.decisions.other: {rubric}: {count} decisions, {labelled} labelled by what you did

devflow.asks.enable.question: Switch Devflow on in {project}?
devflow.asks.enable.why: Its agents get the Devflow tools; the click writes enabled: true in its devflow.yaml.
devflow.asks.enforce.question: Enforce Decisions in {project}'s Devflow?
devflow.asks.enforce.why: Its gates then block instead of only logging; the click writes mode: enforce.
devflow.asks.command.question: Run a team layer's gate command in {project}?
devflow.asks.command.why: {detail} — code from outside the project, asked again whenever it or its commit changes.
devflow.checks.empty: No checks: nothing proves a card done until one is added.
devflow.checks.emptyRelease: No release checks: a long suite, such as E2E, runs here once for a release, not for each card.
devflow.checks.commandPlaceholder: command, run from the project's root
devflow.custom.says.stages: The stages a card goes through, in order, and who approves the brief and the plan.
devflow.custom.says.checks: What devpit runs from the project's root to prove a card done. Each becomes a script under .devpit/devflow/scripts/.
devflow.custom.says.reviewers: Who reads a card's change: each reviewer a persona on one of your agent CLIs, all running at once on your own subscription. A persona nobody runs is reviewed by the session itself.
devflow.custom.says.jev: Whether Jev judges the gates against a rubric. It starts in shadow, recording without holding anything.
devflow.custom.previewBody: The file and everything else Create puts under .devpit/devflow/. Nothing is written until you create it, and devpit never commits.
devflow.jev.title: Ask Jev at the gates
devflow.jev.said: The brief, the plan, each finding and the card's criteria with their evidence are judged against a rubric — never the diff — with no retention and no training.
devflow.jev.enforceSaid: a failing rubric holds the card
devflow.jev.shadowSaid: answers are recorded, nothing is held
devflow.jev.startsInShadow: It starts in shadow. Enforcing is a click of yours once Devflow is set up.
devflow.jev.noAccuracy: No rubric has judged anything here yet, so there is no accuracy to show.
devflow.jev.keyAndProvider: Key and provider in Settings → Decisions
devflow.decisions.noKey: no key — set one in Settings → Decisions
devflow.pane.outside: devflow.yaml changed outside this screen — read again.
devflow.pane.invalidBody: The Devflow tools are off in this project until it reads again; its agents keep only the three that set it up, to fix it.
devflow.pane.disabledBody: Its agents do not get the Devflow tools until you activate it: the click writes enabled: true.
devflow.pane.activeBody: Each change below is written to devflow.yaml at once; devpit never commits it.
devflow.pane.noProject: Open a project to see its Devflow.
devflow.pane.offEverywhereBody: No agent gets a Devflow tool while it is off in Settings.
devflow.reviewers.modelPlaceholder: small, large or a model id
devflow.reviewers.title: Reviewers
devflow.reviewers.body: Each runs headless on your own CLI and subscription, all at once. A persona nobody runs is reviewed by the session itself.
devflow.reviewers.none: No reviewer: the session reviews every persona itself.
devflow.settings.codexBody: Codex sessions get the stages as {skill}. Its hooks need nothing installed: they ride devpit’s own launch line.
devflow.settings.codexSure: This runs {add}, then {plugin}, which writes Codex’s own configuration for every session it starts.
devflow.settings.title: Devflow
devflow.settings.said: Briefing, context, plan, execution, review and completion, served to agents through devpit's MCP. Off, every project's agents see exactly the tools they had before Devflow, and sessions already open hear it.
devflow.settings.presetTitle: A new project’s setup starts from
devflow.settings.presetBody: What the Devflow screen offers first, and what devpit_devflow_setup uses when an agent names no preset. Nothing is written until someone says yes.
devflow.setup.readOnly: Read only · each command looked for, none run
devflow.setup.noChecks: No test, E2E or lint command in the repository’s own files.
devflow.setup.decisionsSet: Set up — Jev starts in shadow
devflow.setup.decisionsNotSetWhy: — the gates run on the checks alone
devflow.setup.offTitle: Devflow is off in this project
devflow.setup.offBody: Its agents get none of Devflow’s tools, skills or hooks. Activating it shows what devpit found here and the setup it would write, before anything is written.
devflow.setup.created: Written to .devpit/devflow/. devpit never commits: commit these files yourself. Devflow stays off here until you activate it.
devflow.setup.lede: A short engineering flow for this project’s cards — briefing, context, plan, execution, review and completion — served to its agents by devpit’s MCP. Nothing is set up here yet: there is no {file}.
devflow.setup.recommendedBody: The checks found above, one security reviewer, and a plan you approve before anything runs.
devflow.setup.customBody: Choose the stages, checks, reviewers and Jev step by step, then read the file before it is written.
devflow.setup.foot: Either way the files go to .devpit/devflow/ in this repository. devpit never commits them, and Devflow stays off here until you activate it.
devflow.stages.own.gate: Own stage, gated by the rubric {gate}
devflow.stages.own.skill: Own stage: following its skill is the stage.
devflow.stages.says.briefing: The goal, for whom and what success is, written as an epic card.
devflow.stages.says.context: The code, glossary and decisions the work stands on, gathered before planning.
devflow.stages.says.plan: The epic's cards, each with criteria and the cards it waits on.
devflow.stages.says.execution: A card's change, proved by the checks devpit runs for its evidence.
devflow.stages.says.review: The change read by the reviewers below, findings merged into one list.
devflow.stages.says.completion: The gate: a card is done when its evidence says so.
devflow.stages.addBody: {project} in .devpit/devflow/skills/, {personal}, {skills} for one already installed, or a team’s {team}. Its skill is read where it is, never copied. A gate command must exit 0 for a card to be done.
devflow.stages.cardsInLabel: Where the plan's cards are made
devflow.stages.nextCardsLabel: When a card releases the cards waiting on it
devflow.standalone.pluginNone: Not installed in {where}. devpit's Devflow does not need it; it is the standalone devflow, for sessions outside devpit's.
devflow.standalone.twiceBody: The plugin is on and so is devpit’s Devflow in this project: its agents get both sets of tools. Switch one off.
devflow.standalone.binaryNote: The binary is for other tools; devpit’s own Devflow does not use it.
devflow.standalone.binarySure: This downloads devflow {known} for this machine from github.com/jholhewres/devflow, refuses it unless it matches the release’s checksums.txt, and puts it at {path}.
devflow.standalone.mcpTitle: devflow as an MCP server in other tools
devflow.standalone.mcpBody: Each tool runs {command} for its own sessions. devpit’s Devflow does not need it.
devflow.standalone.mcpSure: Not added. This writes devflow into {file}, leaving the rest of it as it is.
devflow.teams.fetch: pinned at {commit}, which is not on this machine yet: look at it to fetch it
devflow.teams.waitsLocked: {wanted} waits for your approval; {locked} still applies
devflow.teams.waits: {wanted} waits for your approval; nothing of it applies yet
devflow.teams.approved: {name} at {ref} approved and pinned in devflow.lock. devpit never commits: commit it with devflow.yaml.
devflow.teams.locked: Locked by a layer, so this project cannot change them: {list}.
